verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair question for a scheduling product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Reclaim.ai offers source code, a container image, or an open-source license. Reclaim is documented only as a hosted calendar assistant working with Google and Outlook. The hosted, auth-gated MCP endpoint and a user building their own sync tool do not count toward self-hosting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full scheduling engine from source or a container image under an open-source license
